source: Project-owner supplied manually curated research candidates
selection_method: Long-History Diversified Research Universe: exact 60 project-owner candidates across 11 sectors, prioritizing long observed price histories; no runtime substitution or index-weight ranking. Historical continuity must be audited separately.
limitations: Manual current research selection, not historical point-in-time index membership. Survivorship and hindsight selection bias remain.
The requested start date does not imply every security existed or traded in 1995.
Provider-mapped predecessor and share-class histories are retained only as explicitly flagged research proxies; no histories are manually spliced.
No historical point-in-time investability certification is inferred from price availability.
